moments.author: Linda Yaccarino
moments.quote: When @elonmusk and I first spoke … I’m immensely grateful to him for entrusting me with … transforming X into the Everything App.
moments.why: Her resignation after two years at X is dominating tech and culture conversations among men thinking about leadership and platform shifts.

moments.author: Jay Clayton
moments.quote: “super intelligence is a national security issue”
moments.why: A big shift in framing AI as a national security priority—men in tech, finance, and policy are buzzing about it.

moments.author: Donald Trump
moments.quote: The name is now superintelligence. That’s not a hoax, in fact it’s the exact opposite.
moments.why: Trump rebrands AI to 'superintelligence'—this bold linguistic pivot is sparking massive debate.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.why: Musk switching to Trump’s preferred term 'SI' sets off chatter on branding, AI, and Musk’s alignment with DC.
